character.motivation: Rang the bell during the flood. Wants somebody else to learn how to call the valley together.
character.voice: Careful pacing and language about sound and distance.
character.backstory: Opal rang the bell until the floodwater reached the low road. Across the pond, some people heard it as a wedding call and stayed where they were.
character.quest_hook: Work with Opal and Otto to choose a flood signal residents can recognize by sound or lamplight, then try it from both banks.

dialogue.introduction: We ring for births and storms. I still don't know what we're supposed to ring when somebody finally comes home.
dialogue.friendship: When the water rose, I rang until the rope burned my hands. Across the pond, somebody thought it was a wedding.
dialogue.supper: I rang once when the last person got a plate. I think that could be the sound for coming home.
dialogue.hearing: The bell can announce the next hearing. I'll teach somebody else to ring it too.
dialogue.favorite_gift: I'll leave it below the bell. Nobody thinks to look up and see who put it there.
dialogue.disliked_gift: Please don't bring fish up the bell tower. I have enough trouble with the gulls.

routine.home_context: Chose the high terrace after learning how differently people heard the flood bell below.
